"""Reproduce the old retry assertion after a controlled 2.4-second clock advance."""
import ast
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import textwrap
import time
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch

root = Path('/workspace/scratch/b1afafbe4fcd/repo')
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tests'))
import test_ees_workflow_execution as original

name = 'test_only_classified_rate_limit_retries_once_within_declared_budget'
source = subprocess.run(
    ['git', 'show', '9b2df315e3a1e6e91e06196b3f161e9a19ebd90a:tests/test_ees_workflow_execution.py'],
    cwd=root, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf-8').stdout
method = next(node for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source))
              if isinstance(node, ast.AsyncFunctionDef) and node.name == name)
body = textwrap.dedent('\n'.join(source.splitlines()[method.lineno - 1:method.end_lineno]))
needle = '    self.assertFalse(await self.runtime.process_once())'
assert body.count(needle) == 1
body = body.replace(needle, '    execution.time.time.return_value += 2.4\n' + needle)
namespace = dict(vars(original))
exec(compile(body, '<old-test-with-controlled-delay>', 'exec'), namespace)
old_with_delay = namespace[name]

async def reproduce(self):
    with patch.object(original.execution.time, 'time', return_value=time.time()):
        await old_with_delay(self)

case = type('PriorClockAssumption', (original.ExecutionTests,), {name: reproduce})
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite([case(name)]))
expected = len(result.failures) == 1 and not result.errors and 'True is not false' in result.failures[0][1]
print('EXPECTED_PRIOR_ASSERTION_FAILURE=' + str(expected))
raise SystemExit(0 if expected else 1)
